configurations.name: Expo Web as Live (live server + live Supabase)
runtimeArgs: cd frontend && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && export APP_SUPABASE_URL="$SUPABASE_URL" APP_SUPABASE_KEY="${SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY:-$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY}" && unset EXPO_PUBLIC_COMING_SOON && trap 'kill 0' EXIT TERM INT && (npx expo start --web --port 8085 --non-interactive --clear &) && sleep 3 && node scripts/preview-as-live.mjs
